Interface RouterFunctions.Builder

Enclosing class:
RouterFunctions
public static interface RouterFunctions.Builder
表示路由器功能的可发现构建器。通过RouterFunctions.route()获取。
Since:
5.2
Author:
Arjen Poutsma, Sebastien Deleuze, Rossen Stoyanchev

    • GET

      <T extends ServerResponse> RouterFunctions.Builder GET(String pattern, RequestPredicate predicate, HandlerFunction<T> handlerFunction)
      Adds a route to the given handler function that handles all HTTP GET requests that match the given pattern and predicate.

      例如，下面的路由将针对"/user"的 GET 请求（接受 JSON）转发到userController中的listUsers方法：

      RouterFunction<ServerResponse> route =
    RouterFunctions.route()
        .GET("/user", RequestPredicates.accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON), userController::listUsers)
        .build();
      Type Parameters:
      T - 由处理函数返回的响应类型
      Parameters:
      pattern - 要匹配的图案
      predicate - 用于匹配的附加谓词
      handlerFunction - 用于处理所有匹配 pattern 和谓词的 GET 请求的处理函数。
      Returns:
      此构建器
      See Also:
      • PathPattern
      • RequestPredicates

    • POST

      <T extends ServerResponse> RouterFunctions.Builder POST(String pattern, RequestPredicate predicate, HandlerFunction<T> handlerFunction)
      Adds a route to the given handler function that handles all HTTP POST requests that match the given pattern and predicate.

      例如，下面的路由将包含 JSON 的 "/user" POST 请求转发到 userController 中的 addUser 方法：

      RouterFunction<ServerResponse> route =
    RouterFunctions.route()
        .POST("/user", RequestPredicates.contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON), userController::addUser)
        .build();
      Type Parameters:
      T - 由处理函数返回的响应类型
      Parameters:
      pattern - 要匹配的图案
      predicate - 用于匹配的附加谓词

      此构建器

    • add

      <T extends ServerResponse> RouterFunctions.Builder add(RouterFunction<T> routerFunction)
      Adds the given route to this builder. Can be used to merge externally defined router functions into this builder, or can be combined with RouterFunctions.route(RequestPredicate, HandlerFunction) to allow for more flexible predicate matching.

      例如，下面将 `OrderController.routerFunction()` 返回的路由函数添加到 `userController` 中的 `changeUser` 方法：

      RouterFunction<ServerResponse> route =
    RouterFunctions.route()
        .GET("/users", userController::listUsers)
        .add(orderController.routerFunction());
        .build();
      Type Parameters:
      T - 处理函数返回的响应类型
      Parameters:
      routerFunction - 要添加的路由函数
      Returns:
      此构建器
      See Also:
      • RequestPredicates

    • nest

      <T extends ServerResponse> RouterFunctions.Builder nest(RequestPredicate predicate, Supplier<RouterFunction<T>> routerFunctionSupplier)
      Route to the supplied router function if the given request predicate applies. This method can be used to create nested routes, where a group of routes share a common path (prefix), header, or other request predicate.

      例如，下面会创建一个带有"/user"路径谓词的嵌套路由，因此对"/user"的 GET 请求将列出用户，而 POST 请求将创建新用户：

      RouterFunction<ServerResponse> nestedRoute =
    RouterFunctions.route()
        .nest(RequestPredicates.path("/user"), () ->
            RouterFunctions.route()
                .GET(this::listUsers)
                .POST(this::createUser)
                .build())
        .build();
      Type Parameters:
      T - 处理器函数返回的响应类型
      Parameters:
      predicate - 用于测试的谓词
      routerFunctionSupplier - 如果谓词适用，则委托给嵌套路由函数的供应器。
      Returns:
      此构建器
      See Also:
      • RequestPredicates

    • nest

      RouterFunctions.Builder nest(RequestPredicate predicate, Consumer<RouterFunctions.Builder> builderConsumer)
      Route to a built router function if the given request predicate applies. This method can be used to create nested routes, where a group of routes share a common path (prefix), header, or other request predicate.

      例如，下面会创建一个带有"/user"路径谓词的嵌套路由，因此对"/user"的 GET 请求将列出用户，而 POST 请求将创建新用户：

      RouterFunction<ServerResponse> nestedRoute =
    RouterFunctions.route()
        .nest(RequestPredicates.path("/user"), builder ->
            builder.GET(this::listUsers).POST(this::createUser))
        .build();
      Parameters:
      predicate - 用于测试的谓词
      builderConsumer - 用于提供嵌套路由函数的 Builder 的消费者。
      Returns:
      此构建器
      See Also:
      • RequestPredicates

    • path

      <T extends ServerResponse> RouterFunctions.Builder path(String pattern, Supplier<RouterFunction<T>> routerFunctionSupplier)
      Route to the supplied router function if the given path prefix pattern applies. This method can be used to create nested routes, where a group of routes share a common path prefix. Specifically, this method can be used to merge externally defined router functions under a path prefix.

      例如，下面创建一个嵌套路由，其"/user"路径谓词委托给在`userController`中定义的`router` 函数，并且有一个"/order"路径委托给`orderController`：

      RouterFunction<ServerResponse> nestedRoute =
    RouterFunctions.route()
        .path("/user", userController::routerFunction)
        .path("/order", orderController::routerFunction)
        .build();
      Type Parameters:
      T - 由处理函数返回的响应类型
      Parameters:
      pattern - 要匹配的图案
      routerFunctionSupplier - 如果模式匹配，则委托给嵌套路由函数的供应器。
      Returns:
      此构建器
      See Also:
      • PathPattern

    • filter

      <T extends ServerResponse, R extends ServerResponse> RouterFunctions.Builder filter(HandlerFilterFunction<T,R> filterFunction)
      Filters all routes created by this builder with the given filter function. Filter functions are typically used to address cross-cutting concerns, such as logging, security, etc.

      例如，下面的代码会创建一个过滤器：如果请求不包含必要的身份验证标头，则返回 401 Unauthorized 响应：

      RouterFunction<ServerResponse> filteredRoute =
    RouterFunctions.route()
        .GET("/user", this::listUsers)
        .filter((request, next) -> {
            // check for authentication headers
            if (isAuthenticated(request)) {
                return next.handle(request);
            }
            else {
                return ServerResponse.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED).build();
            }
        })
        .build();
      Type Parameters:
      T - 要过滤的处理器函数的类型
      R - 函数返回的响应类型
      Parameters:
      filterFunction - 用于过滤此构建器构建的所有路由的函数
      Returns:
      此构建器

    • before

      RouterFunctions.Builder before(Function<ServerRequest, ServerRequest> requestProcessor)
      Filter the request object for all routes created by this builder with the given request processing function. Filters are typically used to address cross-cutting concerns, such as logging, security, etc.

      例如，以下示例创建一个过滤器，在处理器函数执行之前记录请求。

      RouterFunction<ServerResponse> filteredRoute =
  RouterFunctions.route()
    .GET("/user", this::listUsers)
    .before(request -> {
      log(request);
      return request;
    })
    .build();
      Parameters:
      requestProcessor - 一个转换请求的函数
      Returns:
      此构建器

    • after

      <T extends ServerResponse, R extends ServerResponse> RouterFunctions.Builder after(BiFunction<ServerRequest, T, R> responseProcessor)
      Filter the response object for all routes created by this builder with the given response processing function. Filters are typically used to address cross-cutting concerns, such as logging, security, etc.

      例如，以下示例创建一个过滤器，在处理器函数执行后记录响应：

      RouterFunction<ServerResponse> filteredRoute =
    RouterFunctions.route()
        .GET("/user", this::listUsers)
        .after((request, response) -> {
            log(response);
            return response;
        })
        .build();
      Type Parameters:
      T - 要过滤的处理器函数的类型
      R - 函数返回的响应类型
      Parameters:
      responseProcessor - 一个转换响应的函数
      Returns:
      此构建器

    • onError

      <T extends ServerResponse> RouterFunctions.Builder onError(Predicate<Throwable> predicate, BiFunction<Throwable, ServerRequest, T> responseProvider)
      Filters all exceptions that match the predicate by applying the given response provider function.

      例如，以下示例创建一个过滤器，当发生 `IllegalStateException` 时返回 500 响应状态：

      RouterFunction<ServerResponse> filteredRoute =
    RouterFunctions.route()
        .GET("/user", this::listUsers)
        .onError(e -> e instanceof IllegalStateException,
            (e, request) -> ServerResponse.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build())
        .build();
      Type Parameters:
      T - 由处理函数返回的响应类型
      Parameters:
      predicate - 要过滤的异常类型
      responseProvider - 一个用于创建响应的函数
      Returns:
      此构建器

    RouterFunctions.route()
        .GET("/user", this::listUsers)
